goal: Add an Ecosystem section to the published Map Dex.

phases.deliverable: fixed goal, scope, ordering, acceptance criteria, and stop-after-trial rule
derive species and type trends and render the Ecosystem section
add a setting-consistent ecosystem explanation to all maps
dedicated tests, full checks, diff and conflict review
pull requests, safe merges, Pages and published-game verification, then stop

acceptance_criteria: an unlocked map detail has a visible Ecosystem heading
the section includes a map-specific ecosystem explanation
the section includes type trends derived from existing weighted encounter data
the section includes main resident species derived from existing encounter data
locked maps reveal no ecosystem information
all existing map IDs, encounters, rates, encyclopedia numbers, and saves remain compatible
mobile layout and reduced-width behavior are covered by automated checks
the published game is verified after Pages succeeds
